frontmatter.title: Computing Vorticity from MPAS Data with UXarray

affiliations.name: NSF National Center for Atmospheric Research

children.value: Open an MPAS unstructured-grid NetCDF dataset with UXarray
Compute vorticity from the 10-meter wind components
Visualize the result as a shaded polygon plot

import uxarray as ux
import numpy as np
import holoviews as hv

hv.extension("matplotlib")
print(f"UXarray version: {ux.__version__}")

uxds = ux.open_dataset(grid_path, data_path)
uxds

Plot the two wind components alongside the derived vorticity using UXarray’s
polygon renderer with matplotlib as the backend.

plot_kwargs = dict(width=600, height=300, backend="matplotlib")

p_u = u10.plot.polygons(
    title="u10 — Zonal Wind (m/s)",
    cmap="RdBu_r",
    clim=(-20, 20),
    **plot_kwargs,
)
p_v = v10.plot.polygons(
    title="v10 — Meridional Wind (m/s)",
    cmap="RdBu_r",
    clim=(-20, 20),
    **plot_kwargs,
)
p_vort = vorticity.plot.polygons(
    title="Relative Vorticity (s⁻¹)",
    cmap="RdBu_r",
    clim=(-100, 100),
    **plot_kwargs,
)

(p_u + p_v + p_vort).cols(1)
